body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.94

Released on 2026-11-25.

You can render one part of a film in a single pass, in any format and frame rate, with HDR video and shader transitions. Project files, media paths and captured videos stay inside the project, and code that reads media input options by position works again.

## Features

- **Studio Server:** The render route renders a part of the film when asked for a start and end ([d2d527952](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d2d527952b7f551185d460f1c1b1e194971727c1), [#8787](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8787)).
- **Producer:** Render a part of the film with HDR video or shader transitions ([66aba4c7a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/66aba4c7a0b7475d964d22ae2491d22d7e89fb48), [#8802](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8802)).
- **Producer:** Render a part of the film in one pass, in any format and frame rate ([13ef667e6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/13ef667e61cdb7d67b3c69cbf4168b87e3a685ba), [#8794](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8794)).

## Fixes

- **Parsers:** HTML a browser reads differently is refused before it is rewritten ([4864ade28](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4864ade2838704b92c69d37ec5ffe554ddca4114), [#8760](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8760)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview no longer shows the frame before the playhead after a save ([b975bbed4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b975bbed4badcccd084718430dcf6bd67796f8ea), [#8818](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8818)).
- **Share:** Exclude private paths from portable project files ([44d49a521](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/44d49a5219b63494b23515f22960fee59931fe80), [#8804](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8804)).
- **Studio:** A sealed resize of a size-tweened layer saves a keyframe and stays where dropped ([5f70c5e3b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5f70c5e3bb729f2c82aa04c6cdcd4f765444bff7), [#8799](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8799)).
- **Studio:** The preview opens only the project's compositions ([df0297366](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/df0297366e803d58d643c485ff9c43ee0408a6a1), [#8725](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8725)).
- **Parsers:** Callers that read mediaInputFormatArgs by position get the format list again ([fb8e7eba9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fb8e7eba924a80d25d47023b7e1c3895616576ba), [#8806](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8806)).
- **Parsers:** Text in a title or textarea can no longer close it when a document is saved ([d15883f30](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d15883f302303a532459e54680778b23912d0f22), [#8805](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8805)).
- **Engine:** A page that keeps throwing looks up each error's throw site once, a few in all ([7d9a14418](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7d9a14418b05d77483c9f0db37b7e5837387ecdb), [#8810](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8810)).
- **Studio:** Apply-to-scope writes only the grading attribute, exactly as given ([14d582c0f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/14d582c0f50e90c4820b8a54a78e0655e386754e), [#8767](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8767)).
- **Skills:** Helper outputs replace a link at their name instead of writing through it ([4920a939b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4920a939bc645cb268b2d767af67a0c041f39d8c), [#8667](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8667)).
- **Studio:** A sealed empty box drags on the press right after its select click ([614ece8bb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/614ece8bb8d3c9a878112932eb8711aff5d61ecc), [#8772](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8772)).
- **Studio:** The dev Studio serves project files only through its API ([92e19cfd4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/92e19cfd4a4c5230993d73d2c04478abe9516fcf), [#8721](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8721)).
- **Engine:** Read only the host's own cgroup layout for memory and CPU limits ([182716eaa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/182716eaa6fcff7dc49841f865ed8f758bf829ea), [#8803](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8803)).
- **Parsers:** Media paths resolve to absolute paths, and only http(s) skip the literal-name check ([3339cb8dd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3339cb8ddab30f10d6082d60c384300fdc8d1763), [#8740](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8740)).
- **Player:** A sealed player fails a cross-site film without the runtime as unsealed does ([fbdfd188c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fbdfd188c46237a516078ee5272620dfcdd63b02), [#8558](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8558)).
- **Engine:** Playlist walk judges an HLS list's segments as one stream ([32618ac51](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32618ac514cbaa607a50021ac3d7924e3dd5db75), [#8798](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8798)).
- **Studio Server:** Delete, cut, group and ungroup decline a script, style or page-shell target ([2a03de9f1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2a03de9f1fe25ba0489401ff959eb23e0c9ab083), [#8801](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8801)).
- **Studio:** A sealed preview's timeline shows a composition nested in a sub-composition ([6e7c35f3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6e7c35f3a90832bc8e348881d090675c560ca38d), [#8736](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8736)).
- **Studio:** A timeline delete takes its clips out of a sealed preview at once ([02cef8e07](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/02cef8e072c71b238b848cb92a168c59763a8f97), [#8719](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8719)).
- **Studio:** An open text edit keeps its typing when a project file changes outside Studio ([8c67cd536](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8c67cd536a4c2641ba33212cb404fc49610d58de), [#8690](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8690)).
- **Sdk:** A text edit never writes into a script, style or other non-content element ([a9d967e1f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a9d967e1f692abd8e9a5424a7288b6ac2a4dbf1d), [#8795](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8795)).
- **CLI:** Captured videos are saved only under a video name the tool chose ([8f335ae59](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8f335ae59bab63511bce470f0ee85009c93735e5), [#8750](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8750)).
- **CLI:** A whisper model is named by one plain file-name part, never a path or link ([082d6f6ed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/082d6f6edbd28320e33a8d2e0f146e88293c6a3a), [#8755](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8755)).
- **Producer:** Auto GPU mode measures its choice once per machine and reuses it ([d55ecae30](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d55ecae30e30974613c910588fb741c4936beafa), [#8788](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8788)).
- **Engine:** A render keeps and logs the page's console and error text only up to a fixed size ([37b8f2647](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/37b8f2647d55670fa170d5363846fd2d687c308a), [#8727](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8727)).
- **Producer:** A private project file stays private under any path spelling ([ff34919fb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff34919fb244c69d1482783fc272b3dad52135ba), [#8786](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8786)).
- **CLI:** Capture checks the page's token result before using it ([c7e19fdd2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c7e19fdd24cc55ea316495c0429cf142be72c716), [#8766](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8766)).
- **Studio:** An element description keeps only a selector Studio would have built ([32681eedc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/32681eedc2f5480b9427ca66432d8a5b4f7ae347), [#8789](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8789)).

## Internal

- **Deps:** Bump vite to 6.4.6 ([934de7b9b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/934de7b9b66f5243dd5fcaaa884b08f286fd2095), [#8815](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8815)).
- A PR author's own comment can carry the Studio and player captures ([559ad7b6d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/559ad7b6d9569bd286cd4a0e5fb895610d02c220), [#8800](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8800)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.93

Released on 2026-11-25.

Telemetry turns off the same way everywhere with DO_NOT_TRACK or HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY, and a cached whisper model is used only when its checksum matches. Media commands and playlists read only local, self-contained inputs, and auto GPU mode picks software rendering when it is faster.

## Fixes

- **Studio:** Words selected in a sealed text edit show the formatting toolbar, as unsealed ([d4edc6d14f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4edc6d14faa62a7d9c6b3adb4aeb8b868ba6648), [#8777](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8777)).
- **CLI:** A cached whisper model is used only once its sha256 matches its pin ([5c4f5febbc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5c4f5febbcd7e4493542d2d7465c0ff46af4b807), [#8762](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8762)).
- **CLI:** DO_NOT_TRACK and HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY turn telemetry off the same way everywhere ([20b020d192](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/20b020d192c77dfedfdbc98fd81b8402ec95c056), [#8781](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8781)).
- **Producer:** Auto GPU mode renders in software when software captures faster ([c5ed60fc83](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c5ed60fc83ab239bcc5e2abc83f2362af9d7af61), [#8785](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8785)).
- **Studio:** Agent prompts keep composition values in quoted fields, after the person's request ([25ad0d1f08](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/25ad0d1f08b757970eae1f0715e9cbef764aa69d), [#8779](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8779)).
- **Core:** A sealed snapshot carries the tweens GSAP's global timeline runs ([ab7f81c8a6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ab7f81c8a6acf636895e594d38d338a8acb4522d), [#8774](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8774)).
- **Core:** A colour-graded video no longer adds a stray row to the Studio timeline ([b31b148f74](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b31b148f747169c6b723823caa03b4242fbb9a85), [#8776](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8776)).
- **CLI:** Media commands read only local, self-contained inputs ([4af0e9c09b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4af0e9c09b4b939a85a75029a28e20429fca42ac), [#8782](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8782)).
- **Engine:** Playlist walk refuses entries with no path and tagged lists ([bf689be3ba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bf689be3bafae591f9a9f541e6229c873a7fc504), [#8784](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8784)).

## Catalog

- **Engine:** A registry or download refusal no longer says it was a capture ([cb9dfa8f0c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cb9dfa8f0c9edef155493e1393dd7981efbda015), [#8791](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8791)).

## Internal

- **Player:** The sealed media table counts only a load that changes crossorigin as the helper's ([59bac900aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/59bac900aa534728ee7137cd69965cae3fce6eec), [#8773](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8773)).
- **Studio:** Soft reload wait rows stop failing on a slow Windows runner ([77dbc72d74](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/77dbc72d74d36d4e455211a6b72d94d756ad8643), [#8778](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8778)).
- **Studio:** Preview walks read the frame Studio shows, not one Chrome re-lays out mid-shot ([886e5d4f43](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/886e5d4f43bc930601ed047d0181f895883764d2), [#8780](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8780)).
- **Engine:** Fit the engine size budget to the playlist folder walk ([ab4d38d512](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ab4d38d5126dbc5a89eee6e50044c3838f7b3811), [#8790](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8790)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.92

Released on 2026-11-24.

A Studio rename now names the files it left on the old path, and sealed previews save moves and resizes like unsealed ones. Renders no longer stop on a URL Node cannot parse, and local media, LUT paths and pasted edits stay where they belong.

## Features

- **Core:** A sealed preview answers a text toolbar's authored styles and fonts ([36d576395](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/36d57639584d0534c32e816c87d9baf2a1683fd0), [#8761](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8761)).
- **Studio:** Long audio keeps its fx and beats, read from the server, no page OOM ([630409ca1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/630409ca19e13bf3400d1d2180bc8c14932970b7), [#8622](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8622)).

## Fixes

- **Lint:** Audio_volume_tween_overrides_gain hint keeps the level the author set ([ca64f8b5d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ca64f8b5de709c56694ec184e5f8b8c0b25c1041), [#8689](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8689)).

body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.91

Released on 2026-11-24.

Local voice and tts now speak a narration line as written. Tts replaces a link at its output name with the audio file. Capture keeps an SVG link attribute only under its plain or xlink name.

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Tts replaces a link at its output name with the audio file ([45846f1e6d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/45846f1e6d5609462d29652315d0d4254fe92c24), [#8707](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8707)).
- **CLI:** Speak a narration line as written in local voice and tts ([99ccd54c63](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/99ccd54c6369cfd5aab43e83a1dfd441e5fdf791), [#8706](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8706)).
- **Studio Server:** Preview head scripts land in the head when an attribute holds <head> text ([07e03e8fed](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/07e03e8fed3846ccbf0d79f9ec0b145b3e308fae), [#8704](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8704)).
- **CLI:** Capture keeps an SVG link attribute only under its plain or xlink name ([42ad487987](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/42ad487987b7e7f61b10fda341338f2caa10020f), [#8705](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8705)).

## Catalog

- **Registry:** Inline the warm-grain starter's grain texture ([93309f35cd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/93309f35cda894adab3e13ba66b1cd2e81618569), [#8712](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8712)).
- **Docs:** Copied catalog wiring reads back as the values shown ([716a89e571](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/716a89e571e2e8f94ecc84934741b02dd1592a66), [#8715](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/8715)).
